messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "do not use tablet if not broken correctly and piece is too big or too small"
set: ["do not use tablet if not broken correctly and piece is too big or too small", "difference between too little and too much is small", "do not swallow tablet", "do not use if frozen", "do not use if cloudy or discolored", "too much sedation", "feeling too hot", "do not use if particles present", "do not push tablet through foil or may damage tablet", "do not double up if dose is not controlling symptoms", "do not suck on the tablet", "Passing too much fluid", "drinking too much alcohol", "do not take tablets too close to bedtime if you have trouble falling asleep or staying asleep", "do not use a teaspoon or tablespoon", "swallow regular tablet whole and do not crush, chew, or break"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
